تعتقلوا (form VIII)
# تَعْتَقِلُوا (taʕtaqilū) /taʕ.ta.qi.luː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَقَلَ (iʕtaqala)
# تُعْتَقَلُوا (tuʕtaqalū) /tuʕ.ta.qa.luː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَقَلَ (iʕtaqala)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
